name: Rishub Tamirisa
bio:
I'm currently working on scaling autonomous science at [Intology.](https://www.intology.ai/)

I graduated from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. My prior research has focused on developing adversarially robust safeguards and alignment techniques for LLMs. My work has been accepted at ICLR, CVPR, NeurIPS, and ICML; also featured in *Wired*.

Previously, I was a founding engineer at [Mindy Group,](https://techcrunch.com/2024/02/13/mindy-get-backing-from-sequoia-to-build-an-email-based-ai-assistant/) a Sequoia-backed AI startup. I also co-led [Lapis Labs,](https://lapis.rocks) a student-led research group, and worked at NASA.
